definition_zh: 田园风情的；乡野的；牧歌式的
definition_en: of or relating to the pleasant aspects of the countryside and country life
core_image: 牧人吹笛，牛群在山坡缓缓移动
scene: 画家支起画架，山坡上牛群懒懒地嚼草。He spent the summer painting bucolic scenes of the valley.
sceneCN: 这里 bucolic 是「田园风光的、牧歌式的」（第 1 个义项：形容乡野宜人景象）；句意是他整个夏天都在画山谷的田园景致。

pos.zh: 田园风情的；牧歌式的；乡土的

derivatives.zh: 由形容词加 -ly 构成，义为「田园式地，乡土气息地」
近义词，义为「田园的，牧歌的」（拉丁同源成分）
相关词，义为「牧歌，田园对话诗」

senses.title: Of the pleasant countryside
senses.titleCN: 田园风光的；乡野宜人的
senses.definition: relating to the attractive, simple aspects of rural life and scenery
senses.definitionCN: 与乡村生活及景致中质朴宜人的一面相关
senses.example: They traded the city for a bucolic farmhouse.
senses.exampleCN: 他们抛下城市，换了一座田园农舍。
senses.why: The Greek root boukolos is a cowherd; herding life stands for idealized country scenes.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语词根 boukolos 意为牧牛人，放牧生活成为理想化乡村的代称。

senses.title: Of pastoral poetry
senses.definition: relating to poetry or literature that idealizes shepherd life
senses.definitionCN: 与美化牧人生活的诗歌文学相关
senses.example: Virgil's bucolic verse shaped the whole tradition.
senses.exampleCN: 维吉尔的牧歌奠定了整个传统。
senses.why: The cowherd moved from the field to the page: rural subjects became a literary genre.
senses.whyCN: 牧牛人从田野走上书页，乡村题材凝定为一种文学体裁，义项由景入文。

senses.title: A pastoral poem
senses.definition: a short poem about rural or shepherd life
senses.definitionCN: 以乡村或牧人生活为题材的短诗
senses.exampleCN: 这部选集重印了十五首牧歌。
senses.why: An adjective of genre slips into a noun naming the work itself.
senses.whyCN: 表体裁的形容词顺势转指作品本身，完成由形容到名词的转化。

senses.title: Rustic and unsophisticated
senses.titleCN: 乡土气的；土里土气的（略带贬义）
senses.definition: suggesting the countryside in a way that seems simple or unsophisticated
senses.definitionCN: 带有乡土气息，显得质朴甚至缺乏教养
senses.example: His bucolic manners amused the city guests.
senses.exampleCN: 他土气的做派把城里客人逗乐了。
senses.why: What the city idealizes as charm, it also patronizes as rusticity.
senses.whyCN: 城市既把乡土美化为魅力，也把它俯视为土气，义项由褒转贬。

intro.en: Bucolic descends from Greek boukolikos, the adjective of boukolos, a cowherd.
intro.cn: bucolic 源自希腊语 boukolikos，即 boukolos（牧牛人）的形容词。

items.en: a reconstructed root gwou fed the words for ox and cow.
items.cn: 重构词根 gwou 滋生出表示牛的一族词。

items.en: bous meant ox and boukolos a cowherd, then boukolikos meant pastoral.
items.cn: 希腊语 bous 为牛，boukolos 为牧牛人，boukolikos 义为田园牧歌的。

items.en: bucolicus kept the literary sense in Virgil's pastoral world.
items.cn: 拉丁语 bucolicus 在维吉尔的牧歌世界中沿用文学义。

items.en: bucolic entered English for pastoral poetry, then widened to rural scenery.
items.cn: bucolic 进入英语先指田园诗，后扩展到乡村景致。

items.en: bucolic now paints the countryside as charming, sometimes quaintly backward.
items.cn: 如今 bucolic 描绘乡村之美，有时带几分土气戏谑。

note.en: Bucolic shares a cow-root family and stands beside its pastoral and rustic neighbors.
note.cn: bucolic 与同出「牛」词根的词为一家，并邻接 pastoral、rustic 等近义词。

entries.definitionCN: 滑稽丑角，只是拼形相近，词源无关

entries.definition: relating to shepherds and country life
entries.definitionCN: 田园的，以牧羊为核心意象，与 bucolic 同义场

entries.definition: writing that turns like oxen plowing
entries.definitionCN: 牛耕式书写，同含希腊语 bous（牛）
田园牧歌的，近义核心词

entries.definition: a musical or dramatic rural piece

entries.definitionCN: 农事诗，与牧歌并置的体裁
恬美如画的，安宁宜人的

normalIntro.en: Split the Greek: bou cow plus kolos herdsman gives the picture.
normalIntro.cn: 拆开希腊语：bou（牛）加 kolos（放牧人）画面即出。

normal.en: The cow sound sits right at the front: bu-co-lic.
A cowherd playing a flute is the root image.
normal.cn: 核心画面：吹笛的牧牛人。

normal.en: Pastoral is its Latin twin, from shepherd.
normal.cn: pastoral 是它的拉丁孪生词，来自牧羊人。

normal.en: Georgic is the farming twin, bucolic the herding one.
normal.cn: georgic 管农事，bucolic 管放牧。

normal.en: The noun bucolics names the poems themselves.
normal.cn: 名词 bucolics 指那些牧歌作品。

abstract.en: Hear a flute float over a slow-moving herd.
abstract.cn: 听笛声在缓缓移动的牛群上空飘荡。

abstract.en: Feel afternoon sun warm a hillside of grass.
abstract.cn: 感受午后阳光晒暖一片山坡。

abstract.en: See smoke rise straight from a thatched chimney.
abstract.cn: 看见炊烟从茅屋烟囱笔直升起。

examples.en: The novel opens with a bucolic description of harvest time.
examples.cn: 小说以 harvest 季节般的田园描写开场，写尽了乡野风光。

examples.en: City dwellers dream of a bucolic weekend in the hills.
examples.cn: 城里人向往在山间度过田园式的周末。

examples.en: The course compares ancient bucolics with modern nature writing.
examples.cn: 课程比较了古代牧歌与现代自然写作。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「牛靠你克」——牛「靠」着「你」在坡上吃草，牧人一点不急，田园牧歌闲适自在。

root: bucolic 来自希腊语 boukolikos，由 bous（牛，上溯原始印欧语重构词根 gwou）加词根 kol-（看管、放牧）构成，指「牧牛人的」，经拉丁语 bucolicus 传入英语，与 pastoral（拉丁语 shepherd 系）同义互补。

sensesIntro.en: The cowherd first stands for the ideal countryside, then for the poetry about it, and finally for rustic simplicity itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 牧牛人先是理想乡村的代称，继而代指歌咏它的诗歌，最后落在乡土的质朴乃至土气上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cowherd piping on a sunny hillside.
core.cn: 核心意象：阳光下山坡上吹笛的牧牛人。

branches.en: bucolic manners seen by city folk
branches.cn: 城里人眼中的土气做派

intro.en: Bucolic is a Greek adjective ending in -ikos that English kept whole.
intro.cn: bucolic 是希腊语 -ikos 形容词的整词保留。

latinIntro.en: The Greek root passed through Latin bucolicus on its way into English.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊词根经由拉丁语 bucolicus 进入英语。
